title: Did you know? The tiniest nations to crash the finals

slides.context: Curacao reached the finals with roughly 156,000 *citizens* — fewer than many mid-size towns. [VERIFY]
In 2018 Iceland debuted at this level with about 338,000 people — once the *smallest* ever. [VERIFY]
Trinidad and Tobago made their *single* finals appearance in 2006, drawing their opener nil-nil. [VERIFY]
